application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
Partial copying fixes a subset of coordinates to an assigned vertex. Its exact one-coordinate recursion is verified on finite sets, with the assignment subset hypothesis retained.
Induction over the copied coordinate set raises the absolute mixed mean to power 2^card(S). The powerset partition contributes each assignment exactly once.
At the full coordinate set, each copied family is constant in the vertex label. This identifies each terminal term with the actual pure subgroup cube average.

Positive dimension supplies nonnegativity of the terminal cube averages and exact Gowers root powers. The resulting root-product inequality and selected-vertex bound require no bound on the selected vertex function.

One definition and seven theorems are individually audited. This completes mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, but does not establish the missing high-order concatenation, Bessel, inverse existence or final coloring extraction.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
